verdict.rationale: Temporal's CLI provides a one-command local dev server (`temporal server start-dev`) that spins up a complete Temporal Service with Web UI, and the TypeScript testing suite explicitly supports a test server with time-skipping for unit/integration testing workflows and workers. Mocked activities/steps are implied by the testing-suite framework but not explicitly detailed in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mocking individual activities/steps in unit tests, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the testing workflow experience.
